base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y -qq cmake libssl-dev pkg-config python3.11-venv patch python3-dev git curl

runtime_profile.notes: TileDB-SOMA requires native library build (libtiledbsoma) which is built during pip install -e. The build requires cmake, patch, and python3-dev. Older setuptools (<70) is required for pkg_resources compatibility. Older anndata (<0.11) and typeguard (<3.0) are required for API compatibility with this codebase. CXXFLAGS=-Wno-error=dangling-reference is set conditionally for g++ 13+ compilers to work around spdlog/fmt compatibility issues (not needed for g++ 12).

notes: Base image python:3.11-slim provides git and curl by default, so they do not need to be installed separately in apt-get. The native library libtiledbsoma is built from source during pip install. This requires cmake>=3.21, patch, and python3-dev for building pybind11 extensions. The pkg_resources module requires setuptools<70. Test compatibility requires anndata<0.11 and typeguard<3.0. The setup_runtime.sh script conditionally sets CXXFLAGS=-Wno-error=dangling-reference for g++ 13+ compilers.
